meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review writing", "check documentation style", "audit interface copy", or "apply writing guidelines".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审阅文稿与界面文案，统一风格规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要核对文字是否符合既定写作规范
copy.tagline_en: Review copy and docs to ensure consistent style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to check text against writing guidelines

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按一套写作规范(涉及语气、禁用词、标题、结构、代码格式等)审查你指定的文件或代码,找出不合规之处,并按“文件:行号”的格式输出简洁的问题清单。
howto.when: 当你说“审查写作”“检查文档风格”“审计界面文案”等指令,并提供文件或路径时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个文档的写作规范
say.note: Claude 会按规则检查并输出问题清单。

say.text: 检查 docs 目录下的文档风格
say.note: 会扫描该目录并给出不合规项。
会按规则列出文案中的问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will review the files or patterns you specify against a writing guideline set (tone, banned words, headings, structure, code format, etc.), and output terse, clickable findings in `file:line` format.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to review writing, check documentation style, audit interface copy, or similar, and provide a file or pattern.

say_en.text: Review this document against the writing guidelines.
say_en.note: Claude checks rules and lists violations.

say_en.text: Check the docs directory for style compliance.
say_en.note: Scans that directory and reports issues.
Lists issues found per the rules.
